verses.en: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.pt: E vós estáveis mortos em ofensas e pecados,
verses.en_web: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
verses.en_bbe: And to you did he give life, when you were dead through your wrongdoing and sins,

verses.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
verses.pt: nos quais antes andastes conforme o proceder deste mundo, conforme o príncipe do poder do ar, do espírito que agora opera nos filhos da desobediência.
verses.en_web: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;
verses.en_bbe: In which you were living in the past, after the ways of this present world, doing the pleasure of the lord of the power of the air, the spirit who is now working in those who go against the purpose of God;

verses.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
verses.pt: Entre esses também todos nós antes andávamos nos desejos da nossa carne, fazendo a vontade da carne e dos pensamentos; e éramos por natureza filhos da ira, como também os outros.
verses.en_web: among whom we also all once lived in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
verses.en_bbe: Among whom we all at one time were living in the pleasures of our flesh, giving way to the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and the punishment of God was waiting for us even as for the rest.

verses.en: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.pt: Mas Deus, que é rico em misericórdia, pelo seu muito amor com que nos amou,
verses.en_web: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
verses.en_bbe: But God, being full of mercy, through the great love which he had for us,

verses.en: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
verses.pt: estando nós ainda mortos em nossas ofensas, nos deu vida juntamente com Cristo (pela graça sois salvos),
verses.en_web: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),
verses.en_bbe: Even when we were dead through our sins, gave us life together with Christ (by grace you have salvation),

verses.en: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
verses.pt: nos ressuscitou, juntamente com ele, e nos fez sentar nos lugares celestiais, em Cristo Jesus;
verses.en_web: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: So that we came back from death with him, and are seated with him in the heavens, in Christ Jesus;

verses.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: para mostrar nos tempos futuros as abundantes riquezas da sua graça, pela sua bondade conosco em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
verses.en_bbe: That in the time to come he might make clear the full wealth of his grace in his mercy to us in Christ Jesus:

verses.en: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.pt: Porque pela graça sois salvos, por meio da fé; e isto não vem de vós; é dom de Deus;
verses.en_web: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
verses.en_bbe: Because by grace you have salvation through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is given by God:

verses.en: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.pt: não por obras, para que ninguém tenha orgulho de si mesmo.
verses.en_web: not of works, that no one would boast.
verses.en_bbe: Not by works, so that no man may take glory to himself.

verses.en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.pt: Pois nós fomos feitos por ele, criados em Cristo Jesus para as boas obras, que Deus preparou para que nelas andássemos.
verses.en_web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
verses.en_bbe: For by his act we were given existence in Christ Jesus to do those good works which God before made ready for us so that we might do them.

verses.en: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.pt: Portanto, lembrai-vos de que vós, antes, éreis gentios na carne, e chamados de não-circuncidados pelos que se chamam participantes da circuncisão na carne, feita por mãos humanas;
verses.en_web: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision”, (in the flesh, made by hands);
verses.en_bbe: For this reason keep it in mind that in the past you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are looked on as being outside the circumcision by those who have circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;

verses.en: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verses.pt: que naquele tempo estáveis sem Cristo, excluídos da comunidade de Israel, e estranhos aos pactos da promessa, não tendo esperança, e sem Deus no mundo.
verses.en_web: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
verses.en_bbe: That you were at that time without Christ, being cut off from any part in Israel's rights as a nation, having no part in God's agreement, having no hope, and without God in the world.

verses.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
verses.pt: Mas agora em Cristo Jesus, vós que antes estáveis longe, chegastes para perto pelo sangue de Cristo,
verses.en_web: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: But now in Christ Jesus you who at one time were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

verses.en: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
verses.pt: pois ele é a nossa paz. Dos dois povos ele fez um, e derrubou do meio o muro da separação.
verses.en_web: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,
verses.en_bbe: For he is our peace, who has made the two into one, and by whom the middle wall of division has been broken down,

verses.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
verses.pt: Na sua carne ele desfez a inimizade da Lei dos mandamentos que consistia em ordenanças, para criar em si mesmo os dois em um novo homem, fazendo a paz;
verses.en_web: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;
verses.en_bbe: Having in his flesh put an end to that which made the division between us, even the law with its rules and orders, so that he might make in himself, of the two, one new man, so making peace;

verses.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.pt: e pela cruz reconciliar com Deus a ambos num só corpo, matando nela a inimizade.
verses.en_web: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.
verses.en_bbe: And that the two might come into agreement with God in one body through the cross, so putting an end to that division.

verses.en: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.pt: Ele veio, e proclamou o evangelho da paz a vós que estáveis longe, e aos que estavam perto.
verses.en_web: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
verses.en_bbe: And he came preaching peace to you who were far off, and to those who were near;

verses.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.pt: Pois por meio dele ambos temos acesso ao Pai por um mesmo Espírito.
verses.en_web: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
verses.en_bbe: Because through him the two of us are able to come near in one Spirit to the Father.

verses.en: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.pt: Portanto, já não sois estrangeiros, nem forasteiros, mas sim, concidadãos dos santos, e membros da família de Deus,
verses.en_web: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,
verses.en_bbe: So then you are no longer as those who have no part or place in the kingdom of God, but you are numbered among the saints, and of the family of God,

verses.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
verses.pt: edificados sobre o fundamento dos apóstolos e dos profetas, do qual Jesus Cristo é a pedra principal da esquina.
verses.en_web: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
verses.en_bbe: Resting on the base of the Apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief keystone,

verses.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.pt: Nele o edifício todo, bem ajustado, cresce para ser um templo santo no Senhor.
verses.en_web: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
verses.en_bbe: In whom all the building, rightly joined together, comes to be a holy house of God in the Lord;

verses.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
verses.pt: Nele também vós sois juntamente edificados para serdes morada de Deus em Espírito.
verses.en_web: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: In whom you, with the rest, are united together as a living-place of God in the Spirit.
